Al-Hasan al-Hulwānī narrated to us, he said, I heard Yazīd bin Hārūn mention Ziyād bin Maymūn, and he said:
‘I swore that I would not transmit anything from him or Khālid bin Mahdūj’. .’ Al-Hulwānī said: ‘I heard from Abd as-Samad and I mentioned Ziyād bin Maymūn near him and he charged him with lying’.
